fire2.how: decoded live 2026-11-15 (tools/boost_capture.py with tools/reach_shot_capture.py for the vehicle's place, logs/boost_capture_reach_20261115-184247, Boneyard, controller left trigger): every boost hold set +0x08 0x880048000 (bits 15, 18, 31, 35) with +0x24 1.0 and +0x3C 1.0 (Bot.boost sends +0x3C as the vertical input), on 4808 of 4817 Ghost ticks together. Ghost at full throttle 4.96 u/s unboosted, 8.17 boosted (top 9.6, a 10.7 s hold kept 8 u/s); Banshee 4.89 -> 10.17 (top 12.1). Bot boosts with +0x3C alone ran about 5.5 u/s in 49 matches

the same capture: +0x24, the left trigger's float, 1.0 (0x3F800000, this u64's high half) on every boost hold; the bits are cleared off the hold, so the person's own trigger in the template action never reaches a bot

reload.how: decoded live 2026-11-20 (tools/reload_capture.py, logs/reload_capture_20261120-234526, the owner's own reload, a solo Reach game): every one of his 10 reloads set +0x40 0x110010 (bits 4, 16, 20) for ~0.12 s, 1.11-1.16 s before the magazine filled, and his 5 taps on a full magazine set the same and did nothing; nothing else came on with them (+0x28 bit 8 rises with each shot: fire). Bit 20 (0x100000) is Use held, which native/reach.cpp writes for a bot's action and this table would clear every tick, so it is left out: bits 4 and 16 only. Before: no reload entry and reach.cpp writes none, so a bot's reload press never reached the game (8-26 of ~190 presses a match followed by a fuller magazine: the game's own reload of an empty one). Live check pending: a bot's magazine up within ~1.2 s of its press

ability.how: static 2026-10-31, the local player's input (ghidra/hr_ability_input.c FUN_18005df80): for an ability whose tag is in hold mode it sets +0x08 bit 8 while the ability button is down and nothing else of its own; the press bit (+0x40 bit 31 in the equipment entry) comes only from its toggle-mode branch, and +0x08 bit 16 only while a sprint-type ability (type block 22) runs. So a hold-mode kind sends this button alone, not equipment: bit 8 and the key's own held bits (+0x40 0x3000, decoded with Shift on Oct 24). FUN_18004bc0c keeps bit 8 through a shot for a hold-mode tag only while +0x40 bit 12 is held. FUN_18047fda8 starts the ability while unit +0x1D8 bit 8 is set and stops it when clear.
